# File Image

## Summary
Base-realm renderer for image files. Lives at
`https://cardstack.com/base/file-formats/file-image` (named export
`FileImage`).

## Usage
```gts
import { FileImage } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/file-formats/file-image';

<FileImage @model={{this.imageFile}} />
```
Renders the image from the file's URL with the file-formats sizing
behavior.
File renderers take a FileDef-backed model (an uploaded realm file) — an
example instance requires an actual uploaded file, so these specs document
the contract and defer live examples to a file-fixtures pass (flagged for
review).
